period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January of the same year (as published in UCB's own annual report's 'Evaluation of Quarterly Financial Statements by the Audit Committee and by the Board' table -- a BSEC-mandated corporate-governance disclosure, not a discrete-quarter figure) -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix, same convention as CITYBANK. Re-sourced via fresh PDF download and dual independent re-extraction (see source.source_document). eps_cumulative (1.98) and nav_per_share (24.07) both reproduce exactly from this quarter's own figures divided by 1,054.131m shares outstanding. Together with Q1, Q2 and the already-recorded FY2016 annual figure, net_profit_after_tax_cumulative increases monotonically all year (441.35 → 1,301.29 → 2,082.84 → 2,628.63) with no violations.
